genius.headline: Catherine Debrunner wins Chicago Marathon women's wheelchair race in 1:33:16, reported as a world record
genius.summary: Swiss wheelchair racer Catherine Debrunner won the women's wheelchair division of the Bank of America Chicago Marathon on Oct. 11, 2026, finishing in 1:33:16. NBC Chicago and the Chicago Sun-Times both report the time as a world record. She finished ahead of second-place Tatyana McFadden, who came in at 1:42:01.

quote.text: At least one world record was set on Sunday morning on the streets of Chicago, as Switzerland’s Catherine Debrunner scorched the 26.2-mile course in a time of 1:33:16, setting a new top mark in the women’s wheelchair race.

facepalm.headline: About 800,000 Colorado ballots wrongly include the Front Range Passenger Rail tax question
facepalm.summary: Ballots sent to some voters in Adams, Arapahoe, Douglas and Weld counties include Issue 7A, a sales tax measure for the proposed Front Range passenger train, even though those voters live outside the rail district. The rail district apologized to the four county clerks for a lack of communication about its new boundaries. The Secretary of State's office said only votes from district residents will be counted.

quote.text: The Front Range Passenger Rail District apologized in a letter to the four county clerks offices for a lack of communication that led to the error.
